_comment: GoAgain and Opt are in printed_keywords; GoAgain is unconditional (fires from card DB), Opt here is a conditional effect (opt 1 if boosted), not the Opt keyword. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK filter uses ATTACK_CLASS_IN for Mechanologist (class/talent), ATTACK_TYPE_IN Action, ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN Attack to match 'Mechanologist attack action card'. FLAG_SET flag='boosted_this_turn' matches the marker appended by boost() in ability_keywords.py. OPT amount=1 implements 'opt 1'.
